title: On Hypersurfaces of Space Forms That Are Gradient Yamabe Solitons
summary: This paper studies nontrivial Yamabe gradient solitons occurring as complete immersed hypersurfaces with constant scalar curvature in space forms $\left(\overline{M}^n(C), \overline{g}\right)$. For solitons with non-vanishing gradients, we establish a structural characterization of the soliton by analyzing a regular level set $Σ$ of the soliton function.
